why: ladder.scripted_opponents (eb848fb) against its parent 919406c, plain arm on MockEngine. eb848fb adds one config field, LadderConfig.scripted_opponents, whose default is the two anchors, and passes it to MixMatchmaker. With the default nothing a run does changes, so the only differences are the new key in config.json and what hashes the config: the config hashes, the identity's ladder_digest (it digests the whole ladder block), the run_id derived from the identity, and the manifest's copies of config_hash and run_id in both checkpoints. Weights, moments, state digests, every metric key and value, the alarm table, its parameters and firings, every other checkpoint leaf and every checkpoint file sha are equal. Measured 2026-09-25 11:42 (PDT) with RoyaleGym 30ca79b pinned on both sides and RoyaleSim 8126375.

commit.why: side A is 919406c, side B is eb848fb; pinned so the file holds only this pair of commits

config_json_sha256.why: config.json gains ladder.scripted_opponents; pinned: side A's is the S3 side-B value in s3-plain-vs-490c74c-mock.json, so the plain mock config did not move between 3ff1f22 and 919406c

config_hash.why: the canonical config gains the same field; pinned: side A's is the S3 side-B value

resumed_config_hash.why: the reloaded <run>/config.json carries the same field; pinned: equals config_hash on each side

run_id.why: the run_id is derived from the identity, and the identity's ladder_digest moves with the new field (identity.py digests the whole ladder block with the master seed)

resumed_run_id.why: the resumed process derives the same run_id from the same identity; pinned: equals run_id on each side

ladder.scripted_opponents.0.why: eb848fb config.py: LadderConfig.scripted_opponents, default (scripted:noop, scripted:random_legal); the first default entry, in the anchors' order

ladder.scripted_opponents.1.why: the second default entry, in the anchors' order

ladder_digest.why: identity.py: ladder_digest = digest_of({ladder, master_seed}), so a new ladder field moves it; the same pair on both engines

fresh:manifest:config_hash.why: the manifest's copy of config_hash; pinned: equals the config_hash column

resumed:manifest:config_hash.why: the resumed checkpoint's copy of config_hash; pinned: equals the config_hash column

fresh:manifest:run_id.why: the manifest's copy of run_id; pinned: equals the run_id column

resumed:manifest:run_id.why: the resumed checkpoint's copy of run_id; pinned: equals the run_id column

columns.commit: the comparison is between two commits

columns.run_id: a new config field is a new identity: runs resume only on the build they started on
columns.resumed_run_id: the resumed process names the same new run

identity_fields.changed.why: ladder_digest and no other identity field
